our_title: SCOTCH_dgraphBuildGrid3D checks its parameters only in debug builds; incrval = 0 divides by zero
ran: repro/API-09/stat_f.f90 first version called scotchfdgraphbuildgrid3d (grafdat, 0, 2, 2, 2, 0, 0, ierr) on the pristine 32- and 64-bit ASan trees: 'dgraph_build_grid3d.c:387:13: runtime error: division by zero' then 'Program received signal SIGFPE' on both ranks. The checks at dgraph_build_grid3d.c:306-314 are inside #ifdef SCOTCH_DEBUG_DGRAPH1.
evidence:
#ifdef SCOTCH_DEBUG_DGRAPH1
  if ((dimxval < 1) || (dimyval < 1) || (dimzval < 1)) { /* At least one vertex */
 ...
  if (incrval < 1) {
    errorPrint ("dgraphBuildGrid3D: invalid parameters (2)");
 ...
#endif /* SCOTCH_DEBUG_DGRAPH1 */

fix_options.label: A: make the two parameter checks unconditional
fix_options.summary: Drop the #ifdef around the checks: the values come straight from a public API call.
fix_options.tested: untested: file belongs to the DGR groups; diff applies.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: STYLE.md / his 7.0.17 fixes: unconditional check for anything an API call controls (e.g. 'Add parameter check to `SCOTCH_dgraphRedist()`').

fix_options.label: B: document the constraint only
fix_options.summary: State in p_l.tex that incrval must be >= 1 and the dimensions >= 1.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: He prefers checks for API inputs.
